name: logPHIModification
shortDescription: Records an audit log entry whenever Protected Health Information (PHI) within a MedicalRecord is modified.
description:
Overview

This function records a detailed audit log entry whenever Protected Health Information (PHI) within a MedicalRecord is modified. This ensures a complete audit trail for all changes to sensitive patient data.

Intended use

Invoked as an event handler, specifically on 'post-save' events for the MedicalRecord entity when an update occurs. It captures the details of the modification.

Logic

  1. Receive event data containing the updated MedicalRecord record.
  2. Identify the specific changes made to PHI fields within the MedicalRecord.
  3. Create an audit log entry using ctx.audit.log with action 'PHI_MODIFICATION', resourceType 'MedicalRecord', and resourceId of the modified record.
  4. Include contextual information such as the user who made the modification, the fields changed, and the timestamp.
  5. Return a success status.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • AuditLog
